learning: Iteration 3 showed the forward lead helps bends but brings back line loss and jitter at y=0.07 m. If jitter stays above 0.10, the next controller lever is kd (0.15) before any further geometry change.
notes: Integrator package for the y=0.06 m lead test. Controller is held at iteration 3 settings so the race isolates the sensor lead, with the same +/-0.05 m spread and 16 mm footprints that removed line loss.
rationale: Iteration 3 (51.31) is the best raced design. Its s-bend progress rose from 0.040 to 0.155 and slalom progress from 0.035 to 0.099, but both tracks showed one line-loss event each, steering_oscillation of 0.127 (s-bend) and 0.138 (slalom), and slalom max_error of 0.065 m, past the 0.06 m limit. The oval has sat at progress 0.115 and max_error 0.061 m since iteration 1, so it does not respond to sensing, inertia or track width. The Builder's geometry for this iteration moves the sensor row from y=0.07 m back to y=0.06 m and keeps every other field from iteration 3. I keep the iteration 3 controller unchanged (kp 2.0, ki 0, kd 0.10, base_speed 1.6, last_direction, weights [-2,-1,0,1,2]). This keeps the race attributable to the lead change alone, which is the Builder's stated test. The sensor weights still match the unchanged +/-0.05 m spread, so the signal stays within about +/-2. Expected result: steering_oscillation falls toward 0.09 to 0.11, line_loss_events trends to 0, and the s-bend keeps most of its progress gain. If oscillation is still above 0.10 with max_error at or above 0.06 m, the next step is kd 0.15 or a lower kp, and I will say so in the next feedback.
